$Comment: A standing work station using an Entity-surface mount (Hold.Mount.Surface: 'Entity') instead of a block seat: the player attaches directly to a spawned anchor entity rather than sitting on the block, so they stay upright while working. Reuses the Sawmill's Work/Recipe/Custody shape (WoodPlanks input, no Tool requirement) with only the Hold.Mount group swapped to Entity/Offset. Camera is set to third person so the player can see their own body while mounted. Entity.VisibleAnchorItemId attaches a dropped-item-style marker to the anchor entity so the mount point is visible in world.
